_comment: Scaffolding only — do not invent client secrets. Copy values from Google Cloud Console into vault_logto_google_* then enable the Google connector in Logto Admin.

google_cloud_console.name: Cronnecture Logto (id.cronnecture.com)
notes: Sign-in with Google / OAuth for standard consumer accounts is free — no per-login fee from Google for this flow.
You must create an OAuth client once in Google Cloud (APIs & Services → Credentials).
After creating the Google connector in Logto Admin, copy the exact callback URI Logto shows (usually /callback/<id>) into Google Console.
Then set vault_logto_google_client_id / vault_logto_google_client_secret and paste the same values into Logto → Connectors → Google.
Enable Google on the default tenant sign-in experience.
